title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6: High-Reasoning Open Models for 2026
summary: MiMo-V2.6 provides an open-weights architecture that allows developers to integrate advanced reasoning capabilities into their custom automation workflows.
body_markdown:
## MiMo-V2.6 performance on automation benchmarks


MiMo-V2.6 utilizes reinforcement learning to resolve the logic gaps that previously forced you to use expensive proprietary models for multi-step agentic workflows.


By training the[Xiaomi MiMo Team](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL) flagship models to reason through complex sequences before responding, the architecture moves beyond simple pattern matching to verified self-correction.


### Pro-RL vs Flash-RL performance targets


High-reasoning tasks are now democratized, as the shift to reinforcement learning (RL) allows the Flash variant (309B total / 15B activated parameters) to perform nearly at parity with the larger Pro model.


According to data from[Xiaomi MiMo](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL) , the MiMo-V2.6 Pro-RL scores 53.1 on automation benchmarks, while the MiMo-V2.6 Flash-RL follows closely at 52.3.


With only a marginal difference, you can opt for the lower-latency Flash model for high-throughput tasks like visual coding or cybersecurity without losing significant accuracy.


Compared to MiMo-V2.5 Pro, which scored 16.0, the new RL-driven approach shows a significant improvement in reasoning capability. While the base[Qwen3.5-9B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B) model scores 5.0, the fine-tuned MiMo-V2.6 models show that specialized RL training drives agentic success more than raw parameter count.


### Surpassing proprietary reasoning models


MiMo-V2.6 is the first open-weight series to consistently outperform top-tier proprietary models in specific automation logic tests.


The benchmark data shows MiMo-V2.6 Pro (53.1) outstripped Claude Opus 5, then the flagship for long-running agentic work, which scored 50.3.

Proprietary models no longer hold a monopoly on the reasoning required for sophisticated automation.


In testing via[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro) , MiMo-V2.6 Pro successfully completed invoice field extraction and support ticket sorting tasks. **In our own tests, MiMo-V2.6 Pro got 2 of 3 automation tasks right versus 3 of 3 for gpt-5.4-mini, so accuracy gains over commercial APIs aren't guaranteed across the board.**


> Proprietary models no longer hold a monopoly on the reasoning required for sophisticated automation.
